description: Verifies the simplified Home agent list opens the selected living agent.
steps: Confirm poster-style Home with large OGENIC mascot and agent team
expected: Home visibly uses the poster composition with glossy inline-SVG mascots rather than flat CSS blocks or static mascot images; header shows OGENIC VI with Harness Capability, and Chat opens with LINEAR as the active agent.

description: Verifies the 2D mascot reacts to typing and a real chat request without changing chat behavior.
steps: Type 'สรุปสถานะตอนนี้'
expected: The mascot visibly changes state while typing and thinking, and a non-empty response appears.

name: Show compact no-token playground
description: Verifies the Home playground remains available in a smaller clean section.
steps: Observe the characters and speech bubble
Tap MOTION ON to pause movement
expected: A compact playground shows multiple colorful animated 2.5D characters with clearly visible movement, one scripted cheeky speech bubble, and the motion control can pause them.

steps: Inspect GitHub, Vercel, and Linear rows

name: Show chat backend failure
